title: Chen-2024-neural-10.1038/s42256-024-00824-8
description: A derivative repackaging of the Mendeley Data record ECoG_HB_02, a single participant's hybrid-density electrocorticography (ECoG) high-gamma feature matrix sampled at 125 Hz with synchronised speech audio. The participant is the only one from Chen et al. 2024 who consented to public release of neural and audio data. The raw voltage recordings were not released. The data comprise 372 word trials covering 51 distinct words and are converted to BrainVision format with BIDS sidecars and event annotations. The time axis is discontinuous.
methods_description: As stated in the source paper, ECoG was sampled at 2,048 Hz and downsampled to 512 Hz. Artefactual and epileptiform electrodes were rejected and a common average reference was applied. The Hilbert envelope of the high-gamma band (70-150 Hz) was computed, downsampled to 125 Hz, and z-scored per electrode against pre-stimulus silent baselines. In this derivative the float64 features were cast to float32 BrainVision format, all-zero columns were marked as bad channels, and word trials were encoded as events. The original HB02.h5 file is retained in sourcedata.
